description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_nntp, which models the nntp URI scheme as part of the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties such as default port and browsability, and implements a validation method for nntp URIs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_nntp
classes.description: A class representing the nntp URI scheme with properties for default port and browsability, and a method to validate nntp URIs.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates the given nntp URI by resetting userinfo and query parts. Always returns true.
